+import uuid

+)
+from src.backend.services import document_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["documents"])
+
+
+@router.post("/projects/{project_id}/documents", response_model=DocumentUploadResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def upload_document(
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    file: UploadFile = File(...),  # noqa: B008
+    category: str = Form(...),  # noqa: B008
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    if not file.filename:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No file provided")
+
+    try:
+        cat_enum = DocumentCategory(category)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid category. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocumentCategory)}",
+        )
+
+    file_bytes = file.file.read()
+    if len(file_bytes) > document_service.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, detail="File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    try:
+        doc = document_service.upload_document(
+            db=db,
+            project_id=project_id,
+            file_bytes=file_bytes,
+            original_name=file.filename,
+            category=cat_enum.value,
+            uploaded_by=current_user.id,
+        )
+        return DocumentUploadResponse.model_validate(doc)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/documents", response_model=DocumentListResponse)
+def list_documents(
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+    category: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    items, total = document_service.list_documents(
+        db, project_id, category=category, page=page, page_size=page_size
+    )
+    return DocumentListResponse(
+        items=[DocumentRead.model_validate(d) for d in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.get("/documents/{document_id}", response_model=DocumentRead)
+def get_document(
+    document_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    doc = document_service.get_document(db, document_id)
+    if not doc:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Document not found")
+    return DocumentRead.model_validate(doc)
+
+
+@router.get("/documents/{document_id}/download")
+def download_document(
+    document_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    doc = document_service.get_document(db, document_id)
+    if not doc or doc.is_deleted:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Document not found")
+
+    path = Path(doc.file_path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found on disk")
+
+    return FileResponse(
+        path=path,
+        media_type=doc.mime_type or "application/octet-stream",
+        filename=doc.original_name,
+    )
+
+

+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    success = document_service.soft_delete_document(db, document_id)
+    if not success:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Document not found")
+

+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    versions = document_service.get_document_versions(db, document_id)
+    return [DocumentVersionRead.model_validate(v) for v in versions]

+import uuid

+

+def list_materials(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    q: str | None = None,
+    category_id: int | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[Material], int]:
+    query = db.query(Material).filter(Material.deleted_at.is_(None))
+
+    if category_id is not None:
+        query = query.filter(Material.category_id == category_id)
+
+    if q:
+        search = f"%{q}%"
+        query = query.filter(
+            or_(
+                Material.name.ilike(search),
+                Material.code.ilike(search),
+                Material.description.ilike(search),
+            )
+        )
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(Material.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def get_by_id(db: Session, material_id: uuid.UUID) -> Material | None:
+    return db.query(Material).filter(Material.id == material_id, Material.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()
+
+
+def create(
+    db: Session,
+    name: str,
+    code: str,
+    description: str | None = None,
+    category_id: int | None = None,
+    unit_id: int | None = None,
+    specification: str | None = None,
+    default_lead_time_days: int | None = None,

+        category_id=category_id,
+        unit_id=unit_id,
+        specification=specification,
+        default_lead_time_days=default_lead_time_days,
+    )
+    db.add(material)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(material)
+    return material
+
+
+def update(db: Session, material: Material) -> Material:

+    db.refresh(material)
+    return material

+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(material)

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from typing import Any
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.rfq import RFQ, RFQItem, RFQResponse
+
+
+def create_rfq(db: Session, data: dict[str, Any]) -> RFQ:
+    rfq = RFQ(**data)
+    db.add(rfq)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(rfq)
+    return rfq
+
+
+def get_rfq_by_id(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> RFQ | None:
+    return db.query(RFQ).filter(RFQ.id == rfq_id, RFQ.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()
+
+
+def list_rfqs_for_project(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[RFQ], int, int, int]:
+    query = db.query(RFQ).filter(RFQ.project_id == project_id, RFQ.deleted_at.is_(None))
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(RFQ.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+    return items, total, page, page_size
+
+
+def update_rfq(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, data: dict[str, Any]) -> RFQ | None:
+    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
+    if not rfq:
+        return None
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        if value is not None:
+            setattr(rfq, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(rfq)
+    return rfq
+
+
+def soft_delete_rfq(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
+    if not rfq:
+        return False
+    rfq.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def add_rfq_item(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, data: dict[str, Any]) -> RFQItem:
+    item = RFQItem(rfq_id=rfq_id, **data)
+    db.add(item)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(item)
+    return item
+
+
+def get_rfq_item(db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> RFQItem | None:
+    return db.query(RFQItem).filter(RFQItem.id == item_id).first()
+
+
+def list_rfq_items(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[RFQItem]:
+    return db.query(RFQItem).filter(RFQItem.rfq_id == rfq_id).all()
+
+
+def remove_rfq_item(db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    item = get_rfq_item(db, item_id)
+    if not item:
+        return False
+    db.delete(item)
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def create_rfq_response(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, data: dict[str, Any]) -> RFQResponse:
+    response = RFQResponse(rfq_id=rfq_id, **data)
+    db.add(response)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(response)
+    return response
+
+
+def get_rfq_response(db: Session, response_id: uuid.UUID) -> RFQResponse | None:
+    return db.query(RFQResponse).filter(RFQResponse.id == response_id).first()
+
+
+def list_rfq_responses(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[RFQResponse]:
+    return db.query(RFQResponse).filter(RFQResponse.rfq_id == rfq_id).all()
+
+
+def update_rfq_response(
+    db: Session, response_id: uuid.UUID, data: dict[str, Any]
+) -> RFQResponse | None:
+    response = get_rfq_response(db, response_id)
+    if not response:
+        return None
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        if value is not None:
+            setattr(response, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(response)
+    return response
+
+
+def reject_other_responses(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, selected_response_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
+    db.query(RFQResponse).filter(
+        RFQResponse.rfq_id == rfq_id,
+        RFQResponse.id != selected_response_id,
+        RFQResponse.status == "selected",
+    ).update({"status": "rejected"}, synchronize_session=False)
+    db.commit()

+import json
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.compliance import ChecklistItem, ComplianceChecklist, ComplianceTemplate
+from src.backend.models.compliance import ChecklistStatus as ModelChecklistStatus
+from src.backend.schemas.compliance import (
+    ChecklistItemUpdate,
+    ComplianceTemplateCreate,
+    ComplianceTemplateRead,
+    InstantiateChecklistRequest,
+)
+
+
+def _template_to_read(template: ComplianceTemplate) -> ComplianceTemplateRead:
+    items_data = []
+    if template.items:
+        try:
+            items_data = json.loads(template.items) if isinstance(template.items, str) else template.items
+        except Exception:
+            items_data = []
+    return ComplianceTemplateRead(
+        id=template.id,
+        name=template.name,
+        standard_code=template.standard_code,
+        category=template.category,
+        is_active=template.is_active,
+        items=items_data,
+        created_at=template.created_at,
+    )
+
+
+def list_templates_service(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    standard_code: str | None = None,
+    is_active: bool | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[ComplianceTemplateRead], int, int, int]:
+    query = db.query(ComplianceTemplate)
+    if standard_code:
+        query = query.filter(ComplianceTemplate.standard_code == standard_code)
+    if is_active is not None:
+        query = query.filter(ComplianceTemplate.is_active == is_active)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    templates = (
+        query.order_by(ComplianceTemplate.created_at.desc())
+        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
+        .limit(page_size)
+        .all()
+    )
+
+    items = [_template_to_read(t) for t in templates]
+    return items, total, page, page_size
+
+
+def create_template_service(
+    db: Session,
+    data: ComplianceTemplateCreate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+) -> ComplianceTemplateRead:
+    template = ComplianceTemplate(
+        name=data.name,
+        standard_code=data.standard_code,
+        category=data.category,
+        is_active=True,
+        items=json.dumps([item.model_dump() for item in data.items]),
+    )
+    db.add(template)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(template)
+    return _template_to_read(template)
+
+
+def get_template_service(db: Session, template_id: uuid.UUID) -> ComplianceTemplateRead | None:
+    template = db.query(ComplianceTemplate).filter(ComplianceTemplate.id == template_id).first()
+    if not template:
+        return None
+    return _template_to_read(template)
+
+
+def _recalculate_checklist_status(checklist: ComplianceChecklist) -> None:
+    items = checklist.items
+    if not items:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value
+        checklist.completed_at = None
+        return
+
+    total = len(items)
+    completed = sum(1 for item in items if item.is_completed)
+    mandatory_items = [item for item in items if item.is_mandatory]
+    mandatory_completed = sum(1 for item in mandatory_items if item.is_completed)
+
+    if completed == 0:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value
+        checklist.completed_at = None
+    elif mandatory_completed < len(mandatory_items):
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value
+        checklist.completed_at = None
+    elif completed == total:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.COMPLETED.value
+        checklist.completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    else:

+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.document import Document, DocumentCategory
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/projects")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID, category: str) -> Path:
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id) / "documents" / category
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return d
+
+
+def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, category: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = _ensure_dir(project_id, category)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def _get_latest_version(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID, original_name: str) -> Document | None:
+    return (
+        db.query(Document)
+        .filter(
+            Document.project_id == project_id,
+            Document.original_name == original_name,
+            Document.is_deleted == False,
+        )
+        .order_by(Document.version.desc())
+        .first()
+    )
+
+
+def upload_document(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    file_bytes: bytes,
+    original_name: str,
+    category: str,
+    uploaded_by: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> Document:
+    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")
+
+    latest = _get_latest_version(db, project_id, original_name)
+    version = (latest.version + 1) if latest else 1
+    previous_version_id = latest.id if latest else None
+
+    file_path, mime_type = _save_file(project_id, category, original_name, file_bytes)
+
+    doc = Document(
+        project_id=project_id,
+        name=original_name,
+        original_name=original_name,
+        file_path=file_path,
+        category=category,
+        version=version,
+        previous_version_id=previous_version_id,
+        size_bytes=len(file_bytes),
+        mime_type=mime_type,
+        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,
+    )
+    db.add(doc)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(doc)
+    return doc
+
+
+def list_documents(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    category: str | None = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[Document], int]:
+    query = db.query(Document).filter(Document.project_id == project_id, Document.is_deleted == False)
+    if category:
+        query = query.filter(Document.category == category)
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(Document.uploaded_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+    return items, total
+
+
+def get_document(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> Document | None:
+    return db.query(Document).filter(Document.id == document_id, Document.is_deleted == False).first()
+
+
+def soft_delete_document(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    doc = get_document(db, document_id)
+    if not doc:
+        return False
+    doc.is_deleted = True
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def get_document_versions(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Document]:
+    doc = get_document(db, document_id)
+    if not doc:
+        return []
+
+    all_versions: list[Document] = []
+    current: Document | None = doc
+    while current:
+        all_versions.append(current)
+        if current.previous_version_id:
+            current = db.query(Document).filter(Document.id == current.previous_version_id).first()
+        else:
+            current = None
+
+    return all_versions

+import uuid

+def _task_to_dict(task: Task, include_subtasks: bool = False, include_deps: bool = False) -> dict:
+    assignee_name = task.assignee.name if task.assignee else None
+    creator_name = task.creator.name if task.creator else None
+
+    subtasks = []
+    if include_subtasks:
+        for st in task.subtasks:
+            if not st.is_deleted:
+                subtasks.append(_task_to_dict(st, include_subtasks=True))
+
+    deps = []
+    if include_deps:
+        for d in task.dependencies:
+            deps.append({
+                "id": str(d.id),
+                "task_id": str(d.task_id),
+                "depends_on_task_id": str(d.depends_on_task_id),
+                "created_at": d.created_at,
+            })
+
+    return {
+        "id": task.id,
+        "project_id": task.project_id,
+        "parent_id": task.parent_id,
+        "title": task.title,
+        "description": task.description,
+        "status": task.status,
+        "priority": task.priority,
+        "assignee_id": task.assignee_id,
+        "assignee_name": assignee_name,
+        "created_by": task.created_by,
+        "creator_name": creator_name,
+        "due_date": task.due_date,
+        "estimated_hours": task.estimated_hours,

+        "updated_at": task.updated_at,
+        "subtasks": subtasks,
+        "dependencies": deps,
+    }
+
+
+def _check_cyclic_dependency(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, depends_on_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    visited = set()
+    queue = deque([depends_on_id])
+    while queue:
+        current = queue.popleft()
+        if current == task_id:
+            return True
+        if current in visited:
+            continue
+        visited.add(current)
+        deps = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(TaskDependency.task_id == current).all()
+        for dep in deps:
+            queue.append(dep.depends_on_task_id)
+    return False
+
+
+def _get_incomplete_dependencies(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Task]:
+    deps = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(TaskDependency.task_id == task_id).all()
+    incomplete = []
+    for dep in deps:
+        blocker = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == dep.depends_on_task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+        if blocker and blocker.status != TaskStatus.DONE.value:
+            incomplete.append(blocker)
+    return incomplete
+
+
+def create_task_service(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID, data: TaskCreate, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict:
+    task = Task(

+    )

+    db.flush()
+
+    create_entry(

+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        after_json={"title": task.title, "status": task.status},
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(task)
+    return _task_to_dict(task)
+
+
+def get_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict | None:
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        return None
+    return _task_to_dict(task, include_subtasks=True, include_deps=True)
+
+
+def list_tasks_service(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    tree: bool = False,
+    assignee_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
+    query = db.query(Task).filter(Task.project_id == project_id, Task.is_deleted == False)
+    if assignee_id:
+        query = query.filter(Task.assignee_id == assignee_id)
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    tasks = query.order_by(Task.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    if tree:
+        task_dicts = [_task_to_dict(t, include_subtasks=True) for t in tasks]
+        return task_dicts, total
+
+    result = []
+    for t in tasks:
+        result.append(_task_to_dict(t))
+    return result, total
+
+
+def update_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, data: TaskUpdate, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict | None:
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        return None
+
+    before = _task_to_dict(task)
+
+    if data.title is not None:
+        task.title = data.title
+    if data.description is not None:
+        task.description = data.description
+    if data.priority is not None:
+        task.priority = data.priority
+    if data.assignee_id is not None:
+        task.assignee_id = data.assignee_id
+    if data.due_date is not None:
+        task.due_date = data.due_date
+    if data.estimated_hours is not None:
+        task.estimated_hours = data.estimated_hours
+    if data.is_deleted is not None:
+        task.is_deleted = data.is_deleted
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(task)
+
+    after = _task_to_dict(task)
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.update",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json=before,
+        after_json=after,
+    )
+    return after
+
+
+def delete_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        return False
+
+    def soft_delete_children(parent_id: uuid.UUID):
+        children = db.query(Task).filter(Task.parent_id == parent_id, Task.is_deleted == False).all()
+        for child in children:
+            child.is_deleted = True
+            soft_delete_children(child.id)
+
+    task.is_deleted = True
+    soft_delete_children(task_id)
+    db.commit()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.delete",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"title": task.title},
+    )
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_task_status_service(
+    db: Session,
+    task_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+) -> dict:
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        raise ValueError("Task not found")
+
+    try:
+        from_status = TaskStatus(task.status)
+        to_status = TaskStatus(new_status)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid status: {new_status}")
+
+    if not can_transition_status(from_status, to_status):
+        raise ValueError(f"Cannot transition from {from_status.value} to {to_status.value}")
+
+    if to_status == TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS:
+        incomplete = _get_incomplete_dependencies(db, task_id)
+        if incomplete:
+            names = [t.title for t in incomplete]
+            raise ValueError(f"Dependencies not done: {', '.join(names)}")
+
+    before_status = task.status
+    task.status = to_status.value
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(task)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.status_change",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"status": before_status},
+        after_json={"status": to_status.value},
+    )
+    return _task_to_dict(task)
+
+
+def add_dependency_service(
+    db: Session,
+    task_id: uuid.UUID,
+    depends_on_task_id: uuid.UUID,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+) -> dict:
+    if task_id == depends_on_task_id:
+        raise ValueError("Task cannot depend on itself")
+
+    existing = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(
+        TaskDependency.task_id == task_id,
+        TaskDependency.depends_on_task_id == depends_on_task_id,
+    ).first()
+    if existing:
+        raise ValueError("Dependency already exists")
+
+    if _check_cyclic_dependency(db, task_id, depends_on_task_id):
+        raise ValueError("Adding this dependency would create a cycle")
+
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        raise ValueError("Task not found")
+
+    blocker = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == depends_on_task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not blocker:
+        raise ValueError("Blocking task not found")
+
+    dep = TaskDependency(task_id=task_id, depends_on_task_id=depends_on_task_id)
+    db.add(dep)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(dep)
+
+    create_entry(

+        user_id=actor_id,

27: ## The core problem
28: RFQ is a multi-step workflow:
29: 1. PM creates RFQ draft against a project
30: 2. PM adds items (referencing materials from catalog, optionally BOQ items)
31: 3. PM selects vendors and "sends" the RFQ (status: draft → sent)
32: 4. Vendors "respond" with pricing (we simulate this via API for now)
33: 5. PM views side-by-side comparison and "selects" a winning response

36: ```
37: GET    /api/projects/{project_id}/rfqs     — list RFQs for project
38: POST   /api/projects/{project_id}/rfqs     — create RFQ draft
39: GET    /api/rfqs/{rfq_id}                  — detail with items

from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class RFQStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    SENT = "sent"
    UNDER_REVIEW = "under_review"
    CLOSED = "closed"
    AWARDED = "awarded"


ALLOWED_RFQ_TRANSITIONS = {
    RFQStatus.DRAFT: {RFQStatus.SENT},
    RFQStatus.SENT: {RFQStatus.UNDER_REVIEW, RFQStatus.CLOSED},
    RFQStatus.UNDER_REVIEW: {RFQStatus.CLOSED, RFQStatus.AWARDED},
    RFQStatus.CLOSED: {RFQStatus.AWARDED},
    RFQStatus.AWARDED: set(),
}


def can_transition_rfq_status(from_status: RFQStatus, to_status: RFQStatus) -> bool:
    return to_status in ALLOWED_RFQ_TRANSITIONS.get(from_status, set())


class ResponseStatus(StrEnum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    SUBMITTED = "submitted"
    SELECTED = "selected"
    REJECTED = "rejected"


class RFQ(Base):
    __tablename__ = "rfqs"
    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    project_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("projects.id"), nullable=False, index=True)

    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False, default=RFQStatus.DRAFT.value)
    submission_deadline: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_by: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
    awarded_to_vendor_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True)
    sent_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    closed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)

    items: Mapped[list["RFQItem"]] = relationship("RFQItem", back_populates="rfq", cascade="all, delete-orphan")

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)

    target_rate: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(18, 2), nullable=True)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)

    rfq: Mapped["RFQ"] = relationship("RFQ", back_populates="items")


class RFQResponse(Base):
    __tablename__ = "rfq_responses"
    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    rfq_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("rfqs.id"), nullable=False, index=True)

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)

    rfq: Mapped["RFQ"] = relationship("RFQ", back_populates="responses")

    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("rfq_id", "vendor_id", name="uq_rfq_vendor"),

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.rfq_repo import (
    add_rfq_item,
    create_rfq,
    create_rfq_response,
    get_rfq_by_id,
    get_rfq_item,
    list_rfq_items,
    list_rfq_responses,
    list_rfqs_for_project,
    reject_other_responses,
    remove_rfq_item,
    soft_delete_rfq,
    update_rfq,
    update_rfq_response,
)
from src.backend.models.rfq import (
    ALLOWED_RFQ_TRANSITIONS,
    RFQ,
    RFQItem,
    RFQResponse,
    RFQStatus,
    ResponseStatus,
    can_transition_rfq_status,
)


def _rfq_to_dict(rfq: RFQ) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": str(rfq.id),
        "project_id": str(rfq.project_id),
        "quote_id": str(rfq.quote_id) if rfq.quote_id else None,
        "title": rfq.title,
        "status": rfq.status,
        "submission_deadline": str(rfq.submission_deadline) if rfq.submission_deadline else None,
        "notes": rfq.notes,
        "created_by": str(rfq.created_by) if rfq.created_by else None,
        "awarded_to_vendor_id": str(rfq.awarded_to_vendor_id) if rfq.awarded_to_vendor_id else None,
        "sent_at": rfq.sent_at.isoformat() if rfq.sent_at else None,
        "closed_at": rfq.closed_at.isoformat() if rfq.closed_at else None,
    }


def _rfq_response_to_dict(response: RFQResponse) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": str(response.id),
        "rfq_id": str(response.rfq_id),
        "vendor_id": str(response.vendor_id),
        "status": response.status,
        "unit_price": str(response.unit_price) if response.unit_price else None,
        "total_price": str(response.total_price) if response.total_price else None,
        "delivery_days": response.delivery_days,
        "validity_days": response.validity_days,
        "notes": response.notes,
        "submitted_at": response.submitted_at.isoformat() if response.submitted_at else None,
    }


def create_rfq_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: dict[str, Any],
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rfq = create_rfq(db, {**data, "project_id": project_id, "created_by": actor_id})
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.create", rfq, actor_id)
    return _enrich_rfq(db, rfq)


def get_rfq_service(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        return None
    return _enrich_rfq(db, rfq)


def list_rfqs_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int, int, int]:
    rfqs, total, page, page_size = list_rfqs_for_project(db, project_id, page, page_size)
    return [_enrich_rfq(db, rfq) for rfq in rfqs], total, page, page_size


def update_rfq_service(
    db: Session,
    rfq_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: dict[str, Any],
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        return None
    if rfq.status != RFQStatus.DRAFT.value:
        raise ValueError("Cannot modify RFQ after it has been sent")

    before_json = _rfq_to_dict(rfq)
    updated = update_rfq(db, rfq_id, data)
    after_json = _rfq_to_dict(updated)
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.update", updated, actor_id, before_json, after_json)
    return _enrich_rfq(db, updated)


def delete_rfq_service(
    db: Session,
    rfq_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        return False
    if rfq.status != RFQStatus.DRAFT.value:
        raise ValueError("Cannot delete RFQ after it has been sent")
    before_json = _rfq_to_dict(rfq)
    success = soft_delete_rfq(db, rfq_id)
    if success:
        record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.delete", rfq, actor_id, before_json)
    return success


def send_rfq_service(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        raise ValueError("RFQ not found")

    if rfq.status != RFQStatus.DRAFT.value:
        raise ValueError(f"Cannot send RFQ in status '{rfq.status}'")

    items = list_rfq_items(db, rfq_id)
    if not items:
        raise ValueError("Cannot send RFQ with no items")

    before_json = _rfq_to_dict(rfq)
    updated = update_rfq(db, rfq_id, {"status": RFQStatus.SENT.value, "sent_at": datetime.utcnow()})
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.send", updated, actor_id, before_json)
    return _enrich_rfq(db, updated)


def close_rfq_service(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        raise ValueError("RFQ not found")

    current_status = RFQStatus(rfq.status)
    if not can_transition_rfq_status(current_status, RFQStatus.CLOSED):
        raise ValueError(f"Cannot close RFQ from status '{rfq.status}'")

    before_json = _rfq_to_dict(rfq)
    updated = update_rfq(db, rfq_id, {"status": RFQStatus.CLOSED.value, "closed_at": datetime.utcnow()})
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.close", updated, actor_id, before_json)
    return _enrich_rfq(db, updated)


def award_rfq_service(
    db: Session,
    rfq_id: uuid.UUID,
    vendor_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        raise ValueError("RFQ not found")

    current_status = RFQStatus(rfq.status)
    if not can_transition_rfq_status(current_status, RFQStatus.AWARDED):
        raise ValueError(f"Cannot award RFQ from status '{rfq.status}'")

    before_json = _rfq_to_dict(rfq)
    updated = update_rfq(
        db,
        rfq_id,
        {"status": RFQStatus.AWARDED.value, "awarded_to_vendor_id": vendor_id},
    )
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.award", updated, actor_id, before_json)
    return _enrich_rfq(db, updated)


def add_rfq_item_service(
    db: Session,
    rfq_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: dict[str, Any],
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        raise ValueError("RFQ not found")
    if rfq.status != RFQStatus.DRAFT.value:
        raise ValueError("Cannot add items to RFQ after it has been sent")

    item = add_rfq_item(db, rfq_id, data)
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.item.add", rfq, actor_id)
    return _enrich_rfq_item(db, item)


def remove_rfq_item_service(
    db: Session,
    rfq_id: uuid.UUID,
    item_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        raise ValueError("RFQ not found")
    if rfq.status != RFQStatus.DRAFT.value:
        raise ValueError("Cannot remove items from RFQ after it has been sent")

    item = get_rfq_item(db, item_id)
    if not item or item.rfq_id != rfq_id:
        raise ValueError("Item not found in this RFQ")

    return remove_rfq_item(db, item_id)


def submit_response_service(
    db: Session,
    rfq_id: uuid.UUID,
    vendor_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: dict[str, Any],
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        raise ValueError("RFQ not found")
    if rfq.status != RFQStatus.SENT.value and rfq.status != RFQStatus.UNDER_REVIEW.value:
        raise ValueError("RFQ is not open for responses")

    unit_price = data.get("unit_price")
    quantity = data.get("quantity", Decimal("1"))
    total_price = (unit_price * quantity) if unit_price else None

    response_data = {
        **data,
        "vendor_id": vendor_id,
        "status": ResponseStatus.SUBMITTED.value,
        "total_price": total_price,
        "submitted_at": datetime.utcnow(),
    }
    response = create_rfq_response(db, rfq_id, response_data)
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.response.submit", rfq, actor_id)
    return _enrich_rfq_response(db, response)


def list_responses_service(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    responses = list_rfq_responses(db, rfq_id)
    return [_enrich_rfq_response(db, r) for r in responses]


def select_response_service(
    db: Session,
    rfq_id: uuid.UUID,
    response_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        raise ValueError("RFQ not found")

    responses = list_rfq_responses(db, rfq_id)
    response = next((r for r in responses if r.id == response_id), None)
    if not response:
        raise ValueError("Response not found")

    reject_other_responses(db, rfq_id, response_id)
    updated = update_rfq_response(db, response_id, {"status": ResponseStatus.SELECTED.value})
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.response.select", rfq, actor_id)
    return _enrich_rfq_response(db, updated)


def reject_response_service(
    db: Session,
    rfq_id: uuid.UUID,
    response_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
    if not rfq:
        raise ValueError("RFQ not found")

    updated = update_rfq_response(db, response_id, {"status": ResponseStatus.REJECTED.value})
    record_rfq_event(db, "rfq.response.reject", rfq, actor_id)
    return _enrich_rfq_response(db, updated)


def _enrich_rfq(db: Session, rfq: RFQ) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from src.backend.db.repositories.vendor_repo import get_by_id as get_vendor_by_id

    items = list_rfq_items(db, rfq.id)
    responses = list_rfq_responses(db, rfq.id)

    vendor_name = None
    if rfq.awarded_to_vendor_id:
        vendor = get_vendor_by_id(db, rfq.awarded_to_vendor_id)
        vendor_name = vendor.name if vendor else None

    return {
        "id": rfq.id,
        "project_id": rfq.project_id,
        "quote_id": rfq.quote_id,
        "title": rfq.title,
        "status": rfq.status,
        "submission_deadline": rfq.submission_deadline,
        "notes": rfq.notes,
        "created_by": rfq.created_by,
        "awarded_to_vendor_id": rfq.awarded_to_vendor_id,
        "awarded_to_vendor_name": vendor_name,
        "sent_at": rfq.sent_at,
        "closed_at": rfq.closed_at,
        "created_at": rfq.created_at,
        "updated_at": rfq.updated_at,
        "items": [_enrich_rfq_item(db, item) for item in items],
        "responses": [_enrich_rfq_response(db, r) for r in responses],
    }


def _enrich_rfq_item(db: Session, item: RFQItem) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": item.id,
        "rfq_id": item.rfq_id,
        "material_id": item.material_id,
        "boq_item_id": item.boq_item_id,
        "description": item.description,
        "unit": item.unit,
        "quantity": item.quantity,
        "target_rate": item.target_rate,
        "notes": item.notes,
        "created_at": item.created_at,
    }


def _enrich_rfq_response(db: Session, response: RFQResponse) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from src.backend.db.repositories.vendor_repo import get_by_id as get_vendor_by_id

    vendor_name = None
    if response.vendor_id:
        vendor = get_vendor_by_id(db, response.vendor_id)
        vendor_name = vendor.name if vendor else None

    return {
        "id": response.id,
        "rfq_id": response.rfq_id,
        "vendor_id": response.vendor_id,
        "vendor_name": vendor_name,
        "status": response.status,
        "unit_price": response.unit_price,
        "total_price": response.total_price,
        "delivery_days": response.delivery_days,
        "validity_days": response.validity_days,
        "notes": response.notes,
        "submitted_at": response.submitted_at,
        "created_at": response.created_at,
        "updated_at": response.updated_at,
    }


def record_rfq_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    rfq: RFQ,
    user_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    before_json: dict | None = None,
    after_json: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    create_entry(
        db=db,
        action=action,
        entity_type="rfq",
        user_id=user_id,
        entity_id=rfq.id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )
